name: Droost AI
description: Bridges Droost to the Drupal AI module: reuses the site's configured embeddings provider for droost_search semantic indexing, and exposes Droost's read-only tools as AI function calls plus an AI code-generation MCP tool. Optional submodule of Droost.
project_description: Droost AI is the optional bridge between Droost and the Drupal AI module (drupal/ai). It does three things. (1) It registers an embedding backend (AiModuleEmbeddingBackend, service droost_ai.embedding) that reuses whatever embeddings provider/model the site configured as its AI default, so droost_search's semantic index can be built without a separate embedding endpoint. (2) It exposes Droost's read-only MCP introspection tools as AI function calls (one derivative per tool via DroostToolDeriver + DroostTool), so the site's chat/assistants/automators can call them on a permitted account's behalf. (3) It adds the droost_ai_generate MCP tool, which generates Drupal code from a natural-language prompt using the site's configured AI chat provider, primed with Droost's house guidelines. It depends on droost_search and the AI module. This documents the 1.0.0-rc1 pre-release of the Droost project.
